description: This file defines the interface 'IZigWave' for ZigBee-related functionalities within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for managing device acceptance, retrieving device metadata, listing devices, and binding/unbinding device connections.

classes.name: IZigWave
classes.description: An interface for ZigBee device management, allowing control over device acceptance mode, device information retrieval, list of devices, and binding/unbinding of device connections.

methods.name: Permutable
methods.description: Checks if a device at a given address can be added to or removed from the network acceptance mode.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a device with a specified ID.

methods.name: Devices
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator over all currently available devices.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Establishes a binding between two device addresses.

methods.name: Unbind
methods.description: Removes a binding between two device addresses.

ctags.name: IZigWave
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IZigWave : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
